lots.title: 2021 RDT 11B MINI EXCAVATOR WI...
lots.findings: NOT a book lot: the 'books' in the catalogue text are the machine's manuals, so the books-and-paper flag is a false match and there are no book titles, spines or title pages to read. The lot is a 1 tonne class Chinese mini excavator with attachments. Compliance plate (photo 6) reads: EXCAVATOR CE, Model RDT-11B, Engine YANMAR, Bucket capacity 0.02 m3, Operating weight 990KGS, Rated power 10KW, Date 01/2021, Serial No 210003. The rear hood decal reads 'POWERED BY YANMAR'. The boom decals read 'S.W.L. 90KG' and a model-style decal that looks like 'QM 12-3' (unclear). It has a canopy ROPS with an amber beacon, rubber tracks, a front blade, a fire extinguisher by the controls and a 'Hire' style sticker on the cab side. Attachments on two pallets (photos 10-11): hydraulic auger drive with hoses, two auger bits (about 12in and 6in, matching the catalogue), a rake, a ripper tine, a mud or batter bucket, a small trenching bucket, a larger digging bucket and quick hitch brackets. The catalogue claims of 2021 and the attachments are supported by the photos. The 40.7 hours is not visible in any photo (no hour meter shown).
lots.condition: Appears in good used order. Paint is mostly intact with light scuffing on the boom, bucket and blade. The canopy roof shows some sun fading. Attachments show normal use, surface rust and dirt. Running condition, hours and hydraulic leaks cannot be confirmed from the photos.
lots.identification: 2021 RDT-11B 1 tonne class Chinese mini excavator, Yanmar-powered (plate: 990 kg operating weight, 10 kW, serial 210003, 01/2021, CE), canopy ROPS, rubber tracks, front blade, with hydraulic auger drive, 2 augers, rake, ripper tine and 3 buckets. Not a book lot: the 'books' are machine manuals. Hours (40.7) not visible in photos.
